scope: Registration.registerProposal of software update proposals signed by a throwaway delegate key (deterministicKeyGen of a fixed seed in Main.hs), against a state of application versions and registered software proposals: the verdict, the refusal's constructor and text, and the registered software proposals after an acceptance; no block, vote or epoch rule is run

registration.note: registerProposal: proposer, signature, then the components (331-391); registerSoftwareUpdate: checkSystemTag of each key of the metadata in Map order, the duplicate, checkSoftwareVersion, svCanFollow (553-597)

systemTag.note: systemTagMaxLength 10 (67-68); checkSystemTag: T.length over it is SystemTagTooLong, then any non-isAscii character SystemTagNotAscii (113-117)

applicationName.note: checkApplicationName: T.length over 12 is ApplicationNameTooLong, then ApplicationNameNotAscii (113-123)
